title: Count Servers that Communicate
summary: Given a m * n grid where 1 indicates a server and 0 indicates no server, count the number of servers that can communicate with at least one other server by sharing the same row or column.
statement: Given a m * n grid where 1 indicates a server and 0 indicates no server, count the number of servers that can communicate with at least one other server by sharing the same row or column.
constraints: A server communicates when another server shares its row or column.
Count communicating servers, not communicating pairs.
hints: Count servers in each row and each column.
A server qualifies when its row count or column count exceeds one.
Scan the grid a second time and count qualifying occupied cells.
The row/column counts exactly encode existence of another aligned server.
editorial: The row/column counts exactly encode existence of another aligned server.

tests.explanation: Neither diagonal server shares a row or column, so the count is zero.
All three servers share a row or column with another server.
